response.sql:
WITH matched_fees AS (
  SELECT f.orderslink, o.ordertune, f.rebtotal, f.rebrate, f.feerate
  FROM fees AS f
  JOIN orders AS o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault
), overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(rebtotal) AS overall_avg_rebate
  FROM matched_fees
), grouped AS (
  SELECT orderslink,
         ordertune,
         AVG(rebtotal) AS avg_rebtotal,
         AVG((rebrate - feerate) / feerate) AS avg_rebate_fee_rate_ratio
  FROM matched_fees
  GROUP BY orderslink, ordertune
)
SELECT g.orderslink,
       g.ordertune AS order_type,
       g.avg_rebtotal,
       g.avg_rebate_fee_rate_ratio,
       g.avg_rebtotal - overall.overall_avg_rebate AS avg_rebate_minus_overall
FROM grouped AS g
CROSS JOIN overall
WHERE g.avg_rebtotal > overall.overall_avg_rebate
ORDER BY avg_rebate_minus_overall DESC
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: The overall average total rebate is computed across all fee records that match an order, using the same starting population as the grouped results; SQLite AVG ignores NULL values.
